summary: Phase-2 backend + frontend testing of Corner Streams. All 30 Phase-1 + 15 new Phase-2 backend tests pass (45/45). Found and fixed one critical bug: PUT /api/subjects returned 500 due to MongoDB ObjectId leaking into response after insert_one mutated the doc. Frontend manually verified: student dashboard, school-admin Subjects tab, teacher CBT tab render correctly; PWA manifest + sw.js reachable.

critical.issue: Returned 500 when creating subjects for a NEW class. Root cause: motor's insert_one() mutates the dict in-place to add `_id: ObjectId(...)`, which FastAPI/pydantic cannot serialize. FIXED by adding `doc.pop('_id', None)` before return.

minor.issue: Login response user object does NOT include `student_id` field even for role=student. JWT carries student_id correctly so /students/me works, but frontend convenience would benefit from echoing student_id in login response (and in /auth/me).

Email is silently lowercased+stripped on insert; the response returns the lowercased value, but the input is mixed-case. Documented behavior (auth uses lowercase emails everywhere) but worth flagging in UI so school admins know how the login was actually stored.

Phase-1 ticket — emergentintegrations Stripe metadata pydantic ValidationError. Phase-2 retest passed (status returned 200); the previously reported bug appears to be intermittent or session-specific. Keep monitoring.

integration_issues.issue: Could not E2E test /cbt/{examId} timer/submit flow because the seeded JSS 1 Mathematics exam has already been attempted (one-shot). To exercise the timer + countdown + submit dialog, create a fresh exam via teacher UI (or via API) and provision a different student. UI inspection of the existing CBT card confirms it renders 'Score: 80% — Done' correctly after the prior submission.

issues: data-testid attributes still NOT present on most interactive controls (login form, dashboard tab triggers, CBT card buttons, Subjects tab actions). System prompt mandates this for robust automated regression. Phase-1 report flagged the same; please prioritise.

action_items: (Optional) Echo student_id in /api/auth/login + /api/auth/me user object for student role for frontend convenience.
(Optional) When school admin provisions student login, return/display the lowercased email so admin knows the canonical login value.

Add data-testid attributes across StudentDashboard (subject cards, CBT card primary action, Result Checker button), SchoolAdminDashboard (Subjects tab trigger, add-subjects button, Create-login button per row, Passport upload button), TeacherDashboard (CBT exams tab trigger, Create exam button, Publish/Unpublish toggle, Attempts dialog trigger), CBTTake (option radio inputs, next/prev/submit buttons, timer label).
Consider seeding a SECOND CBT exam (e.g. JSS 1 English) so the Phase-2 student timer flow can be QA'd manually without first un-attempting the existing one.
Re-validate /api/payments/checkout/status/{session_id} once Stripe SDK metadata error is consistently observed — it passed in this run.
critical_code_review_comments: MongoDB _id leak pattern is repeated risk in routers/subjects.py — fix applied. Audit all routers that do `insert_one(doc); return {..: doc}` (cbt.py uses `doc.pop('_id', None)` correctly; students.py does in `create_student`). Recommend a tiny helper `def serialize(doc): doc.pop('_id', None); return doc`.

routers/cbt.py update_exam mixes dict/model in `update['questions']` post `model_dump()` — current safeguard is fine but slightly defensive code is dead because model_dump() always yields dicts. Cleanup possible.

routers/cbt.py _upsert_score_from_cbt uses `await db.scores.update_one({'id': existing['id']}, ...)` — works, but if Phase-1 stored CA via a different teacher, the source flips to 'cbt' silently. Acceptable per spec but flag for visibility.
auth/login response builder strips `student_id` from User model dump. If User pydantic model doesn't list student_id, add it (Optional[str]) so the field surfaces.
Phase-1 critical comments on missing data-testid attrs and FRONTEND_URL CORS mismatch still stand.

success_rate.frontend: Manual smoke pass on 3 dashboards + PWA

Subjects PUT bug was fixed in this iteration. Pending UI deep tests not done: actually creating a CBT exam through teacher UI dialog with dynamic question rows, Subjects add/edit dialog from school admin, /cbt/{examId} timer countdown + submit dialog (blocked by one-shot attempt rule on the seeded exam), Create-login button per student row.
rca_of_the_issue: Subjects 500: PUT /api/subjects path performed `await db.class_subjects.insert_one(doc)` and immediately returned `{'class_subjects': doc}`. Motor mutates `doc` to inject `_id` (bson ObjectId), which FastAPI's jsonable_encoder cannot serialize → 500. Fix: pop `_id` from the dict before returning. Verified by re-running test_admin_can_upsert_and_delete_subjects (now passes).
